summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.28/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.28 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 26, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 21¢ lower than a week ago, $1.23 lower than a month ago, and 57¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.00) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.63).
